author: omar
text: LED-41 again: duplicate ledger events after the reconciliation consumer rebalanced. That's the third time this quarter and finance caught it before we did.

author: vik
text: Looked at it. The consumer commits offsets after it applies the batch, so a rebalance in between replays the whole batch. We can tune timeouts, but it's whack-a-mole.

author: omar
text: I'd rather fix it at the source: write the ledger row and the event in the same Postgres transaction and relay from an outbox table. Then Kafka only ever sees committed facts.

author: wes
text: From the bus side that's fine. Keep the ledger-events topic and schema as they are and nobody downstream has to change anything.

author: nora
text: Works for me if reconciliation gets simpler. Omar, can you write it up as an ADR so it formally replaces ADR-007? I don't want two answers to how ledger events get published.

author: omar
text: LED-41 is closed with a dedupe guard for now. Drafting ADR-012 for the outbox, comments welcome by Thursday.

author: omar
text: ADR-012 is accepted: ledger events go through a Postgres transactional outbox and ADR-007 is superseded. The topic stays the same.

author: vik
text: Thanks for writing it up. I'll mark ADR-007 as historical in the event bus docs once the relay is live.

author: omar
text: Opened LED-44 for the outbox backlog alert and the retention job for sent rows.

author: nora
text: Reminder: PCI scoping review for the tokenization proposal is Tuesday. Bring questions about the iframe flow.

author: aria
text: Settlement batch ran clean last night after the pool split from PAY-18. Thanks Nora!

author: ben
text: Picked up BILL-4, the giant invoice PDFs. Looks like the renderer holds the whole table in memory.

author: cora
text: Two change-control records landed today for payments-api, CC-0990 and CC-0991, with the same effective time. Has anyone checked whether they agree?

author: nora
text: I approved both without noticing the overlap, my mistake. I'll take it to the change board, please don't act on either one yet.

author: ben

text: Aria still owns billing gateway, ping her.

author: kai

author: cora

author: yara

author: tara

author: milo
text: Orphaned indices from the alias swaps are eating 1.2 TB. Tracking the cleanup in SRCH-12.

author: gus
text: CC-1020 is through. From now on cluster changes go in the Tuesday platform change window, no exceptions without a ticket.

author: eli
text: Autoscaler fix from INFRA-22 is live. Overnight node count dropped from 38 to 17.

author: vik
text: All five brokers are on Kafka 3.8 now. Thanks Wes for babysitting the rolls.

author: fay
text: Terraform defaults for DLQ topics are fixed, 14 days retention. If you created a DLQ by hand, please move it into the module.

author: wes
text: Heads up: once the ledger outbox relay is on, the old direct publisher stops writing to Kafka. ADR-012 has the details.

author: eli
text: Ingress 502s during deploys are gone, preStop hook and draining were the fix (INFRA-27).

author: jun
text: ADR-009 is in: the online feature layer moves to Redis, the offline copy stays in the warehouse.

author: hana
text: Weekend drift pages were a baseline problem, not real drift. Per-day-of-week baselines are live (ML-30).

author: ivan
text: Retrained fraud model with chargeback labels is promoted. AUC up 0.03 on the holdout and fewer false positives.

author: lena
text: The nightly load now waits for late events, BI and finance revenue match again (DWH-3).

author: cora

author: uma
text: ADR-011 is accepted. Card data will be tokenized at payments-api, and the checkout frontend never sees a raw card number.

author: dina
text: Security reminder: no card numbers in screenshots or tickets, not even test ones from production-like systems.
